neighbours.label: nouns for built structures and architectural spaces (cistern, tower, barn, tunnel, amphitheatre, gallery, vault)
fire: Rainwater from the roofs drains into a vaulted cistern under the square.
A square tower of grey stone guards the bridge.
The farmer stores his hay in a timber barn beside the orchard.
Smugglers used a tunnel that ran from the cellar to the beach.
Gladiators fought in the amphitheatre outside the city walls.
The upper floor has an open gallery facing the courtyard.
The abbey kept its wine in a brick vault beneath the refectory.
The harbour is overlooked by two watch towers built by the Genoese.
quiet: Rainwater from the hills drains into a shallow stream beside the square.
A squad of soldiers in grey coats guards the bridge.
The farmer stores his hay under a canvas sheet beside the orchard.
Smugglers used a rowing boat that went from the cove to the ship.
Gladiators trained with wooden swords outside the city walls.
The upper slope has an open meadow facing the valley.
The abbey sold its wine to merchants from the north.
The harbour is watched by two customs officers sent by the Genoese.
